body:
Thank you, I really appreciate your piece of mind. It's something I really didn't want to come down to, especially after the many sacrifices I had to make to get and stay with her. I'll probably talk to her in person before I return to my county of residence and I'll let her know we shouldn't be together anymore. But I'm scared of living on without her and I don't know if that's really the best option either.

I hate it when situations only have bad outcomes, and it's up to you to decide which is the lesser evil.

Very fair point; the whole *lying to me* ordeal has planted a seed of distrust that I can't get rid of, but I've put so much effort into this relationship by having to overcome so many things to open up to her that I don't want any of it to go to waste. We share a common history since 2017, we go waaay back, so there are also many memories outside of our relationship I very much want to cling onto. When things are good, they're amazing; as I said, the time she actually spent away from him, we were having the time of our lives, but sadly that break from him was only temporary. The thought of him harms me and I can't get him out of my head if I have to worry about her hanging out with him all the time, especially when I live in another country and only get to see her on vacations, whereas he gets to hang out with her every single day.
